source.caption: Screening differentially expressed genes in heart failure. (A) Volcano plot of DEGs. Red dots represent up-regulated genes and blue dots represent downregulated genes. (B) Differential gene expression heatmap. (C) Dendrogram of all genes with dissimilarity clustered on topological overlap. (D) The correlation heatmap representing the relationship between different gene modules and status of HF. (E) The venn diagram showing the intersection of DEGs with WGCNA.
